## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` pass
- [ ] A bug fix has a test that fails without it
- [ ] A new tool rule has a test line with the real command line (`loadline explain <pid>`)
- [ ] Behaviour changes are reflected in `docs/how-it-works.md`, `README.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`
